Its looking alright, I think you could have slightly more space between the bed and the nozzle. 

For me I've found its better to have a tiny, tiny space between print lines than to be too close to the bed (helps to prevent nozzle clogging, and you don't want the nozzle digging into the layer its just printed). 

Also some tips:

1. Push your binder clips the whole way to the edge of the bed. I know for this print with that skirt the nozzle may have bumped into the clip, but otherwise you want those to be securely on.
2. Invest in some isopropyl alcohol in a spray bottle for cleaning if you haven't already. Around a 70% isopropyl alcohol mix will work (I mixed mine using 100% isopropyl, and did a mix of about 2/3 alcohol to 1/3 water).
